title: Experiencers' account of breeding experiments and ecological messages
summary: Bob McGwier tells of Experiencers' account of breeding experiments and ecological messages, about undated at Earth, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: following seems to be their story not my story but their story they're doing freting experiments for reasons we don't know

plain: On Jesse Michels's podcast, a man named Bob McGwier passes on what he hears from experiencers, people who say they have had contact with non-human beings. He stresses that this is their story, not his: according to them, the beings are carrying out breeding experiments for reasons no one knows, and they also bring messages about the planet and its environment. If true, it would mean someone is deliberately working on humans and also trying to warn us.
